caption_L1: This is a area chart named Persons employed in home health care services in the U.S. from 2000 to 2019 (in 1,000). There is a linear scale of range 0 to 1,500 on the y-axis, labeled Number of persons in thousands. There is a linear scale from 2000 to 2015 along the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: The number of persons employed in home health care services has risen from just over 0.5 million in 2000 to just under 1.5 million in 2019. The chart shows an upward trend throughout this period, although the number employed in 2019 was below its peak of 1.5 million, which was reached in 2016.
